## About Me

I am a Computer Science graduate specializing in full-stack web engineering and predictive machine learning models.

My work focuses on bridging intelligent algorithms with scalable, practical web architectures that deliver real value.

## Current Focus

| Area | What I am exploring |
| --- | --- |
| **Web Development** | Building scalable full-stack applications, robust API integrations, and responsive user interfaces. |
| **Machine Learning** | Developing predictive neural network models, managing data distributions, and deploying Flask APIs. |
| **Applied AI** | Integrating intelligent models into web architectures to deliver automated and user-centric solutions. |
| **UI/UX Design** | Designing intuitive, clean user interfaces and crafting engaging, modern digital experiences. |
